summary: Chaince Digital Holdings Inc. filed a prospectus supplement for an at-the-market equity offering of up to $300 million of ordinary shares through H.C. Wainwright as sales agent. The ATM agreement dated August 19, 2026 provides for a 3.0% commission on gross proceeds. Shares are listed on Nasdaq under symbol CD, last sale $3.46. The filing is a routine capital-raising transaction under Rule 415(a)(4). No special-situation attributes such as control change, tender offer, or strategic review are present. Watch for potential dilution or selling pressure from ATM draws, but no risk-arb angle.
